cases.name: good
cases.description: The assertion the gateway signs for a forwarded call, presented twenty seconds later.

cases.name: good-params-spelled-differently
cases.description: The digest is of the JSON value, not of its bytes: the same request with other spacing, key order and string escapes is accepted.

cases.name: good-without-roles-client-and-actor
cases.description: A caller with no roles, no client and no actor: roles is an empty list, client and actor are empty.

cases.name: good-signed-with-the-second-key
cases.description: A verifier holding both keys (one is being rotated out) accepts an assertion of either, chosen by kid.

cases.name: good-expired-within-the-skew
cases.description: 30 seconds after exp the assertion is still accepted: the clocks may differ by that much.

cases.name: good-issued-in-the-future-within-the-skew
cases.description: An assertion made 30 seconds ahead of the verifier's clock is accepted.

cases.name: good-audience-as-a-list
cases.description: aud may be a list; it is accepted when it contains this server's endpoint.

cases.name: good-lifetime-of-exactly-5-minutes
cases.description: The longest lifetime a verifier accepts, although the gateway itself makes one of a minute.

cases.name: good-assertion-of-exactly-8192-bytes
cases.description: The longest assertion a verifier reads: 8192 bytes of compact JWS.

cases.name: refused-no-assertion
cases.description: A call with the unsigned caller of a gateway without a key, or of anyone on the network, and no assertion.

cases.name: refused-not-a-jws
cases.description: Something that is not a compact JWS.

cases.name: refused-not-base64url
cases.description: Three parts that are not base64url.

cases.name: refused-over-8192-bytes
cases.description: Longer than a verifier reads (over 8192 bytes), validly signed.

cases.name: refused-claims-are-not-an-object
cases.description: A correctly signed JWS whose payload is a list.

cases.name: refused-alg-none
cases.description: alg none with a gateway kid and an empty signature.

cases.name: refused-alg-hs256-keyed-with-the-public-key
cases.description: The classic confusion: an HMAC made with the gateway's public key (its PEM text) as the secret.

cases.name: refused-another-typ
cases.description: typ JWT: an access token, not a caller assertion, signed by a held key.

cases.name: refused-signed-with-p384-and-es384
cases.description: A P-384 key signing ES384, as someone with a different curve would.

cases.name: refused-signed-with-p384-under-an-es256-header
cases.description: A P-384 signature (96 bytes) under an ES256 header and a held kid: the signature has the wrong size.

cases.name: refused-unknown-kid
cases.description: Signed by a key the verifier does not hold, under that key's own kid.

cases.name: refused-bad-signature-under-a-known-kid
cases.description: Signed by another key under the gateway's kid.

cases.name: refused-claims-swapped-after-signing
cases.description: The gateway's header and signature with other claims.

cases.name: refused-signature-of-the-wrong-size
cases.description: A signature of three bytes.

cases.name: refused-wrong-audience
cases.description: Signed by the gateway for another upstream's endpoint.

cases.name: refused-audience-list-without-this-server
cases.description: aud as a list that does not contain this server's endpoint.

cases.name: refused-expired
cases.description: 31 seconds after exp: beyond the 30 seconds of clock skew.

cases.name: refused-issued-in-the-future
cases.description: Made 31 seconds ahead of the verifier's clock: beyond the skew.

cases.name: refused-lifetime-over-5-minutes
cases.description: exp is 5 minutes and a second after iat.

cases.name: refused-exp-before-iat
cases.description: exp one second before iat (not yet expired at the time of presentation).

cases.name: refused-no-expiry
cases.description: No exp claim.

cases.name: refused-no-issued-at
cases.description: No iat claim.

cases.name: refused-empty-subject
cases.description: sub is the empty string.

cases.name: refused-empty-jti
cases.description: jti is the empty string.

cases.name: refused-no-jti
cases.description: No jti claim.

cases.name: refused-no-request-digest
cases.description: No req claim.

cases.name: refused-params-changed-after-signing
cases.description: The gateway's assertion presented with other arguments than the ones it signed.

cases.name: refused-another-method-than-signed
cases.description: An assertion the gateway made for resources/read, presented on tools/call with the same params.

cases.name: refused-replay
cases.description: The same assertion presented twice: the first is accepted, the second is refused.

cases.name: refused-replay-of-an-id-on-another-request
cases.description: A jti is spent for every request: a second assertion with the same jti is refused although it is for a different request.
